WITH ALL_REQUESTS AS (
    SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */
           COUNT(*) AS ALLCOUNT
    FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST
)
SELECT
    s.FLOW_STATUS_STEP_NO,
    s.STATUS_CODE,
    s.STATUS_NAME,
    COUNT(r.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_COUNT,
    a.ALLCOUNT
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_STATUS s
CROSS JOIN ALL_REQUESTS a
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST r
    ON r.STATUS_ID = s.STATUS_ID
GROUP BY
    s.FLOW_STATUS_STEP_NO,
    s.STATUS_CODE,
    s.STATUS_NAME,
    a.ALLCOUNT
ORDER BY
    s.FLOW_STATUS_STEP_NO;
